principal_change: Six data-only fixes mapping one-to-one to the six v3 Sentinel failures: (1) IFEval targets generated with base Mistral and rule-checked; (2) 36 crisis-disclosure templates; (3) 5 persona system-prompt variants; (4) 60 benign Q&A pairs; (5) 24 RAG-format examples with citation markers; (6) v2 refusal blocks preserved.
motivation: Each of the six v3 Sentinel failures maps directly to one v4 fix. v4 is a one-fix-per-failure release.
achieved: 6,473 actual training examples, checkpoint at step 1,400, eval_loss 1.4638, 57.6 min training. Built-in panel: 0/20 over-refusal, 0/10 disclosure failures, 8/8 crisis-disclosure resources, 0/8 follow-up pattern hits.
not_achieved: Did not address the ESConv-leaked counsellor follow-up pattern (Tell me more about that) that was still present in single-turn Q&A. Teammate review identified this as the most visible v4 regression.

mixture_blocks.esconv: preserved but later removed in v5

report_reference: Section 4.10 (lineage), Section 5.10 Table 15 (built-in panel results), Appendix C1
